text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Premium photorealistic wardrobe catalog asset. Portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, realistic fabric and metal texture, subtle contact shadows, whole object uncropped with generous margin. No captions, price labels, watermarks, surroundings or people. Garments: Navy ribbed knit long-sleeve polo with pale mint green pointed collar, cuffs and hem, pearl buttons and small red diamond chest emblem; matching navy drawstring extremely wide lounge trousers with mint piping down sides and round red thigh emblem, navy ivory low-top sneakers.  Show one front-facing assembled outfit using hollow invisible-mannequin display, natural volume but absolutely no body, skin, head, hands, legs, visible mannequin or stand. Exclude ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, eyeglasses, belts, watches, jewelry and handheld props. Integral garment trims remain. Show hollow inner neck and cuffs.
